Zoe (CS): Heads-up — Novalytics (acct: NLX-42) has an ~85% drop in embeddings + gen traffic starting 2026-04-10. Renewal 2026-06-10. New Head of Data (Marcel) started 2026-04-02 and procurement mentioned a short pilot with EdgeServe + SCIM/SSO checks. Also saw billing ticket open (#BILL-903) marked as disputed. Need triage ASAP.
Priya (AM): Oof. Can you paste the usage snapshot? I'll loop in procurement contact (Raj) and Marcel.
Zoe (CS): Quick query + results:
```sql
SELECT date, sum(calls) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM api_usage
WHERE client_id='NLX-42' AND date >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
-- 2026-04-09 calls=12,430 tokens=2.1M; 2026-04-10 calls=1,520 tokens=160k; 2026-04-11 calls=1,030 tokens=95k
```
Zoe (CS): No 401s, but see a burst of 403s tied to service-account keys on 4/10 and several retries.
analytics-bot: Auto-detect — NLX-42 anomalies: calls down 85%, error-rate 403 spike from 0.1% -> 3.4% on 2026-04-10, avg latency unchanged.
billing-bot: Billing alert — ticket #BILL-903 (disputed invoice) created 2026-04-09. Current account status: active, payment pending.
Priya (AM): Raj (procurement) — can you confirm whether the pilot with EdgeServe involved changing keys or pausing pipelines? Also any procurement gating (SSO/SCIM) blocking prod traffic?
Raj (Novalytics): Hi all — procurement thread: yes, we kicked off a 2-week eval with EdgeServe on 4/10. We also flagged a mismatch in invoice line items and opened BILL-903. We did not intentionally rotate keys but Marcel mentioned they temporarily disabled a few ingestion jobs during the pilot.
Omar (Solutions): I can grep for the 403s and map them to key IDs and IPs. If they disabled jobs, the 403s could be retries from a deprecated key that was revoked. Will post logs.
Celine (Onboarding): If they're testing prompts differently, offer a 30-min prompt tuning + cost breakdown. I can run a quick embed quality check and suggest batch/tuning changes. Wed/Thu availability this week.
Zoe (CS): If keys were rotated accidentally, that explains 403s. But the timing with the pilot + billing dispute could be causing a deliberate pause. We should treat this as renewal risk: they might favor EdgeServe if procurement sees price delta.
Priya (AM): Action owners: Priya -> outreach/exec + procurement, Zoe -> logs + key mapping, Omar -> bench + 403 trace, Celine -> enablement session offer, Billing team -> chase BILL-903. Also draft a low-friction offer: 2-week trial extension + sample cost comparison on their real prompts.
Omar (Solutions): Found 403s tied to key fingerprint fk_48a7 and an IP range the client uses for batch ingesters. Fingerprint shows key was disabled on 2026-04-10 09:17 UTC. Posting short trace: 
```
2026-04-10T09:16:58Z req id=xx user=NLX-42 key=fk_48a7 resp=403 reason=key_disabled
2026-04-10T09:17:02Z req id=yy user=NLX-42 key=fk_48a7 resp=403 reason=key_disabled
```
Zoe (CS): Thanks Omar — that aligns. Suggest we offer a checklist to Marcel: 1) confirm keys in use, 2) recommended batch size 50->20 for mobile pipelines, 3) quick KV cache tip for embeddings.
Priya (AM): Raj replied — they can re-enable jobs but want to finish EdgeServe bench first. Raj asks if we can provide token-cost estimates for his team's sample prompts and a short head-to-head on 3 representative queries.
Celine (Onboarding): I'll prep a 1-pager for Wed 11am PT that covers prompt tuning + cost knobs and reserve a slot. Can also include a short checklist for SSO/SCIM steps and contact for security vetting.
Zoe (CS): I'll monitor logs; will also verify there are no SSO blocks (auth events look normal).
billing-bot: Billing note added to ticket #CS-8012: "Novalytics renewal risk — usage drop + BILL-903 follow-up". Reminder scheduled for 2026-05-20.

If youre running a short pilot with EdgeServe, happy to run a 3-query perf + token cost comparison on your real prompts and extend your trial 2 weeks to make the comparison apples-to-apples. Also we can help validate key rotation/SSO steps. No commitment required. — Priya"
